itemTexts.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
A stout stick covered in pitch.
Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
A highly polished plate of pure silver.
Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
The processed pelt of a silverback wolf; great for clothing and warming. Also very valuable when sold.
It is said that he/she who wears it may be able to see the unseen.
The legendary prized possession of the notorious King Ptaraz, founder of Tanirith.
Famous for its taste, its bouqet, its richness and its strenght; truly a dwarven mead!
Rich, yet not too bitter or too sweet, it is no wonder that this rhum is so popular among connaisseurs.
The finest wine of the whole south-east of the Realmz continent!
Perfectly cut, these rubies are sought for their value and their beauty.
A wonderful relic which belonged to the legendary dwarven hero Galduur.
A powerful blade brought to the Realmz thousands of years ago by a mysterious adventurer named Kith Khanaan.
Some say these helms were made ages ago to combat warriors with mind-powers.
It is said that he who wears this helm shall have the contentment of the simpleton.
Also known as "MageBane", it was created to assassinate powerful mages.
The curse of a medusa shall be inflicted on he/she who wear this suit of armor.
An assassin-for-hire, Rhan the Night made his reputation centuries past by slaying mages.
A superb weapon with a powerful dweomer; unfortunately, it turns its owner into a coward.
An armor much sought after by psionicists and psi-warriors.
This magnificent blade has but one purpose only: to slay anything reptilian, including dragons.
These shields were used ages ago against warriors with mind-powers.
A dark terrible weapon; legends say that it holds the essence of a succubus.
The preferred blade of assassins and murderers for hire.
A fantastic dwarven battleaxe, usually given to dwarven heroes.
Light, yet sturdy and of high quality; made of mithril and special dwarven alloys: very well suited by and for its makers.
The regular weapon of dwarven warriors.
Reinforced boots, yet as comfortable as regular leather boots.
A shield for heroes ... dwarven ones, that is.
A blade made on the continent of Anarym, nothing is known of this wonderful sword.
A much sought after item by psionicists.
A robe much sought after by psionicists.
A terrible item used by slavers to break the will of their slaves.
Usually a gift offered by enemies to break one's will.
He/she who wears this shall be confused by the world around him/her.
A reinforced leather cap.
This is the millennia-lost helm of the mysterious adventurer named Kith Khanaan.
A holy relic of gnomes, given to them by the god Woralduur.
The processed pelt of an animal; great for clothing and warming. Also valuable when sold.
Well-balanced daggers that bear a strong dweomer to increase their accuracy.
A rod useful to help one get out fast of those dead-end situations.
Another item brought over from the continent of Anarym; all that is known is that it belongs to the archlich Druroxx Bane.
A weapon blessed by Erond, God of Knowledge, crafts, and wisdom; created to strike down those who use their intelligence and knowledge toward evil ends.
Your typical leather pouch made to hang on a belt and to hold coins. Just click "Use" in order to partake its contents!
Rumored to be the lost crown of king Ptaraz, founder of Tanirith.
This fine document will allow you to gain entrance into Castle Antrax whenever you wish.

monsterDescriptions.text: Though they are not difficult to kill, take care.  Their bite is most poisonous.
Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together, and you have a four- footed eating machine with sharp teeth.
A strange cross between an ogre and a bear.  These creatures were born of magic long ago.
Fearless and noble warriors, they dedicate their lives in the service of king and country.
These powerful spirits are not to be triffled with in regards to their ward.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for no one has ever found one in a cocoon state.
Master of enchantments, he seeks more power.
Rare and legendary, these good dragons are nearly as powerful as gold dragons!
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to  avoid.
Sickly in appearance, these foul creatures blend into their  surroundings and pounce on the unsuspecting.
Chosen temporal and spiritual leader of all Amazons.
Long dead creatures of a larger race.  Many such creatures were once gnolls, bug bears, ogres or true giants.
Common in some areas of the Abyss that have a cold climate.  No dragon in the Realmz can match this breed when it comes to having a heart of pure evil.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.  These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.
This most beguiling of demons preys on the sexual impulses of mortals.  Taking the shape of a beautiful man or woman, they lure unsuspecting souls to their doom.
The undead guardian of choice.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they look fierce, they are not as deadly as one might think.
Large and deadly.  Their saliva contains a strange chemical.  Those that do not save will become deathly afraid.
Agressive and hungry; this fish doesn't hesitate to attack anything.
The scourge of the snowy wastes.
Master of wizardly magic.
Born of pure evil.  These beautiful, deadly creatures love to inhabit murky forests.
Do not get too close!  If it gets you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
Very rare and evil, the beautiful mane of these strange animals can be sold for large amounts of gold.
Evil animals of the lands.
Still learning magic ... and getting better at it every day!
Pawns of the frost giants.  These weak-minded fools often do the bidding of the giants and fight by their side.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Harpies are considered among the most evil minded of creatures.
A mysterious adventurer.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
The faithful companion of Strider.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few  have met with one AND LIVED!
Capable of breathing lightning.  Woe to the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one such as this.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be reckoned with.
Long ago a tribe of trolls developed the ability to think.  They have since developed a strong tribal society that rivals orcs and goblins.
Evil incarnate, these undead creatures feast on the terror and pain of those they choose as victims.
A grim sell-sword, don't let her fool you with her cute looks!
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your very life force.
Animated dead to do their foul master's bidding.
The sewers are their favorite homes.
Large and heavily armored, with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
Ah yes ... the infamous hill giants. Brutish, ugly ... and brutish.
A hardy warrior trained for horse-riding, combat and charging.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with  keeping the troops in line.
These dragons are a mix of red and emerald dragons. In other words, they're mean and powerful!
Unholy servants with a bad attitude ... towards you!
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
Small, but very deadly!
Still learning the ways of his elder bethren ... unfortunately for you.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts would make excellent warriors if they were not so lazy.
Small pests with a paralyzing bite.
Related to dragonkind, these cunning predators are as good flyers as they are swimmers.
Perhaps the deadliest of monster spiders ...
A better version of your average, run-of-the-mill zombie.
Mother, father or just a related higher cousin, of the small slime.
Voracious and quite acid at that.
Leader of noble knights.
Large and fierce, this race of half bear, half man is feared thoughout the land.
Another underground dweller.
Ruler of the seas ... above them and under them!
Ah yes .... The infamous troll ... Need we say more?
Old, trampy, badly dressed ... and deadly!
Mistress of enchantments. Come and feel her "love" for the first ... and last time.
Undead, animated warrior.
These determined predators often hunt in packs.
Yellow mold.  Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
Leader of the hunting pack!
Magic weaver with willfull intent.
A creature of the undead.  Their bite can produce paralysis.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
Still learning the arts of enchantments, and they need to practice ... on you!
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
Sewer beast which eats all kinds of refuse, even you!
The spiritual leaders of gnomes.
A giant cousin of the game animal we all know and love.
A master of magic one must be wary of!
A lesser version of the mummy.
A tormented soul who finds release by tormenting the living.
Its terrible sight will make you age from abject fear.
Paid, skilled mercenaries who escort and defend merchant caravans for a living.
Horse-riding warriors.
Warriors-for-hire who make a living in leading and defending caravans; leaders of caravan escorts.
Evil incarnate, these Princes of Evil seek only power ... and mayhem.
Though, leader-for-hire of riders.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Fierce humanoids, but somewhat weak and inept.
The ultimate goblin warrior, model to all goblins.
Power-hungry clerics with an attitude.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
A true leader of men.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
Always hungry ... for living flesh.
A five-headed monstruosity; its arsenal of attack is staggering.
Stronger than his peers, this ogre leads small raiding bands.
Abused as a youngster.  These ill- tempered men are common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
With a shell as hard as coral, this crab is mindless machine with powerful pincers.
With a hard carapace as tough as steel plating.  This crab is like a knight in armor.
Brutish, strong and willfull: a typical ogre worthy of the mantle of chiefhood.
Spawn of the Abyss, they serve their only masters: the Demon Lords.
Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.
Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.
A gnat a bit less lazy than his peers ... so of course he leads raiding bands.
A small, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
A disgusting creature at best.  This  beast sports four clawed feet, two tentacles and a elephants trunk.  It's bite can also paralyze.
A tougher, meaner, gnat. Of course, he's the chief!
A mutated form of the garden variety pest.
Capable of casting spells. This humanoid should be feared.
Prefers to feed on the dead.  However, they will not hesitate to add a little fresh meat when it's available.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
The bullies of the Underworld.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
The spiritual leader of a tribe of orcs.
Strong and capable with arms.
There is no doubt as to why and what makes this one the Big Dogre ...
An ordinary gnome trained to defend his town.
Ratus Gigantis.
Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
A paralyzing sting makes this large insect quite deadly.
The game animal we all know and love.
Large and fierce warriors of above average skill.
A goblin warrior skilled in the use of a bow.
A mean, and though, goblin.
A mercenary usually employed by Merchant Lords and other petty Lords for their protection.
The disease-ridden pest of sewers, towns, and cities alike.
A mercenary employed in private armies.
A mercenary employed in private armies.
A mercenary employed in private armies.
A mercenary leader employed in private armies.
A master of stealth and robbery.
He has not risen to head his own thieves' Guild without reasons, you know ...
The epitome of gnomish skills at arms and bravery.
The universal pest.
These fell spirits haunt cemetaries and crypts. Their cold touch will paralyze you with dread.
Say "Hi" to the King of the hill ... giants!
King of the gnomes for a reason (or two, or three ...).
Sturdy and tough little folks who know craftsmanship and how to brawl.
The king of dwarves.
Epitome to all dwarves for bravery and skills in battle.
The pawn of battling armies.
The pawn-for-hire of battling armies.
These evil warriors are usually in the service of dark leaders or powers.
Long ago, a wizard's experiment when awry and this is the result.
Not a nice tree exactly ....
So beautiful and deadly, a true servant of the dark Goddess Tlarantale!
An elf trained in archery .... and very well trained at that!
An elf with great warrior skills ... not to be underestimated!
One of the shadow elves' master of the arcane.
Up to no good, do-it-all-for-loot individual. Sounds familiar?
Well muscled, tough and loyal. No wonder they are paid highly for their services.
The innkeeper of Aranys' famous inn.
Zaran's consort and co-operator of Aranys' famous Wildboar inn.
A noble warrior and adventuress;  a bit secretive however. What mystery lies behind her mesmerizing eyes?
The Merchant Lord of Aranys.
Mordrek, lord Akkar Dhun's Viceroy ... and sorcerer to boot!
A fierce sell-sword who takes no jive from anyone.  And quite attractive too!
As dangerous as any adventurer.
A tougher and meaner dwarf ... if that can be possible!
A dwarf-for-hire ....
A greedy master of commerce, trading, and making money.
A deadly magic-weaver who looks out only for herself.
She has a score to settle with Lord Akkar Dhun!
A true warrior, usually next in line to become a Tribe King.
The cutthroat of the seas.
A scourge of the seas as much as she is beautiful and cunning.
A scourge of the seas as much as he is ruthless and cunning.
No boat could do without them!
No ship can sail without one!
Looking for a fight, especially after he's had one drink too many.
Black marketeer and spy for the Overlords.
A mage looking for adventures, fame, and fortune.
The kidnapped daughter of a rich merchant of Wailsrond.
Mining company owner by day ... Agent of the Overlords by night!
Mining company owner and good-intended Lord of Sparklestone.
A tougher, meaner troglodyte ... as if we needed that!
Rogue Lord by excellence!
Offsprings of green dragons!
A proud, brave, and noble dwarf.
A proud, brave, and noble dwarf.
Greater cousins of Hill giants.
A heroine, and genuine princess, of the amazons.
An agent of the Overlords all along!
Say hello to the King of orcs!
Self-appointed Pirate Queen, with the help of the Overlords!
The corrupted High Comander of the Order of the Knights of the Flame.
Evil Regent of Coral Towers, and treacherous brother of the good Queen Aquillae.
Powerful Merchant Lord of Tanirith, and agent of the Overlords.
Gnome priest and adventurer by excellence.
A holy chosen and warrior to boot to the dwarves.
Small, perhaps even annoying at times, but very brave and reliable to defend his community.
A spiritual leader of furfoot communities.
A noble, selfless, wandering knight.
A noble, selfless, wandering knight.
A typical furfoot that is too curious or self-involved for his own good.
Terrible monsters who burrow in snow and ice, where they live.
Large and fierce, this race of giants is evil through and through.
A terrifying adult red dragon in becoming ...
Your old "pal", now stuck with you on Tarterys Island.
A wreck of a man, doing hard time in Tarterys Island.
A hardened prisoner after years of hard time on Tarterys Island.
A hardened prisoner after years of hard time on Tarterys Island.
A wreck of a man, doing hard time on Tarterys Island.
Hardened after months or years of doing hard time on Tarterys Island, he now has it more easy by working for Halem El-Yessef's gang.
A powerful wizard turned undead in a foolish quest to achieve immortality.
His mind powers are terribly potent. But is he really a mage, or something else even more fearsome?
Unknown, but very skilled and powerful, these warriors rarely speak. Rather, they prefer to let their actions speak for them!
A member of the secretive and mysterious Cult of Lankharh.
A strong-armed leader of pirates ... enough said?
A scourge of the seas as much as she is beautiful and cunning.
A fallen Pirate King who seeks to reclaim his throne from his usurper, the current Pirate Queen.
A fallen Pirate King who seeks to reclaim his throne from his usurper, the current Pirate Queen.
A high-ranking member of the mysterious Cult of Lankharh.
The leader of the mysterious Cult of Lankharh.
A guardian simulacrum.
Another one of those who serve the mysterious Overlords.
Another one of those who serve the mysterious Overlords.
One of many who get paid to kill others, he is quite skillfull in the art of fighting and murder.
A master in the skillfull art of murder.
A sorcerer inflicted with wandering-lust and adventure-seeking.
Set to overthrow her evil uncle, the Regent of Coral Towers.
Set to overthrow her evil uncle, the Regent of Coral Towers.
Set to overthrow the evil Regent of Coral Towers.
Set to overthrow the evil Regent of Coral Towers.
The rightful ruler of Coral Towers.
Good ole Pyrostorm in the flesh and blood!
Your friend Naryl Dragonstone, but now carrying the essence of the Mind Lord Kith Khanaan!
The psionic equivalent of the assassin.
Who ever was stupid enough to coin the phrase "weaker sex"? Obviously, this person never met  one of these fierce and proud warriors!
The living soul of an elven maid who has sworn to protect an elven sacred ground even in her after-life.  Her wail kills any who hears it!
End of list.
